figures.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: one landscape 16:9 Chinese presentation slide for a technical handbook; a finished explanatory PNG, not a product screenshot.
Primary request: explain HiRoute's Jev routing loop using Alibaba Cloud Bailian System One. Make a polished editorial slide with readable, exact Chinese text and a clear feedback loop.
Style: clean flat vector-like PowerPoint graphic, warm white background, dark navy typography, restrained indigo / teal / amber cards, subtle separators, abundant whitespace. No photo, no mascot, no decorative 3D, no provider logos, no UI imitation.
Canvas: wide 16:9. Large title at upper left: "从结构化判断到模型路由". Smaller subtitle below: "HiRoute × 百炼 System One".
Main layout: four equal numbered cards in a horizontal line, connected left-to-right by three arrows. All card headings large; body text high contrast and no smaller than ordinary slide body.
Card 1 exact heading "① 准备状态"; label "HiRoute"; body two lines "当前任务与可见历史" and "state + questions".
Card 2 exact heading "② 结构化判断"; label "百炼 System One"; body two lines "decision-model-preview" and "分类 · 复杂度 · 胜任度".
Card 3 exact heading "③ 应用路由"; label "HiRoute"; body two lines "校验答案与评分范围" and "按已发布策略选择模型组".
Card 4 exact heading "④ 执行任务"; label "原有 Agent"; body two lines "省钱组 / 主力组" and "执行模型响应，继续调用工具".
Under the four cards draw one large returning arrow from card 4 back to card 1. Its exact centered label is "实际执行与阶段证据 → 下一次决策". Make arrow endpoints unmistakable; it must point back to preparation, never between individual decision questions.
Bottom band, exact text: "同轮可继承冻结选择；新用户消息重新判断".
Small footer exact text: "原理示意 · 不代表实验测量".
Constraints: every quoted text must be rendered verbatim with proper Chinese glyphs. Keep System One and decision-model-preview exact. No OpenRouter wording. No made-up scores, no fabricated product UI, no extra claims or extra text. Whole slide visible with comfortable safe margins.

Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: a landscape 16:9 Chinese PowerPoint-style explanatory slide for the HiRoute Jev handbook case, not a product screenshot.
Style: polished flat vector-like editorial diagram, warm white background, dark navy typography, restrained indigo / teal / amber accents, subtle card separators, ample whitespace. Large legible Chinese sans-serif headings and body. No photo, no mascot, no decorative 3D, no provider logo, no UI imitation.
Render all quoted text verbatim using accurate Chinese glyphs; do not add extra text, invented measurements or OpenRouter references. Whole slide visible with comfortable safe margins.

Title at upper left: "三个问题，三个评价对象".
Subtitle: "一次 System One 调用，问题独立判断".
Main layout: three equal tall cards side by side, numbered 1 / 2 / 3 with separate subtle icons. Never draw an arrow from one question to another.
Card 1, indigo, heading "当前做什么？"; type badge "Choice"; body "写稿 / 审稿"; section label "读取 choice"; bottom "选择任务类别".
Card 2, teal, heading "当前有多复杂？"; type badge "Score"; body "直接整理 / 复杂推导"; section label "读取 probabilities"; bottom "在类别内选择模型组".
Card 3, amber, heading "上一阶段做得如何？"; type badge "Score"; body "评价已发生的执行"; section label "胜任度 = score / 2"; bottom "0 / 0.5 / 1 三档锚点".
A shared thin line below the cards collects them toward one centered lower box. Its exact heading is "HiRoute 归约答案"; two lines "只读取选中类别的复杂度" and "胜任度绑定上一实际阶段". The lower box represents deterministic application logic after independent questions, not model questions consulting one another.
At the very bottom an unobtrusive note with verbatim text: "confidence 表示判断把握，不等于简单概率或完成质量".
Small footer: "原理示意 · 不代表实验测量".

Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: a landscape 16:9 Chinese PowerPoint-style explanatory slide for the HiRoute Jev handbook case, not a product screenshot.
Style: polished flat vector-like editorial diagram, warm white background, dark navy typography, restrained indigo / teal / amber accents, subtle card separators, ample whitespace. Large legible Chinese sans-serif headings and body. No photo, no mascot, no decorative 3D, no provider logo, no UI imitation.
Render all quoted text verbatim using accurate Chinese glyphs; do not add extra text, invented measurements or OpenRouter references. Whole slide visible with comfortable safe margins.

Title at upper left: "简单任务，也可能需要主力保护".
Subtitle: "先判断当前复杂度，再核对本次评分是否适用".
Main layout: left one wide teal input card, middle one wide indigo validation card, right two short outcome cards stacked vertically. Connect left to middle, then middle to each right outcome. Avoid overcrowding or tiny text.
Left card heading "示意返回"; large text "简单概率 0.91 ≥ 0.8"; next line "上一阶段 0.96 / 2 = 0.48"; next line "胜任度 0.48 < 0.5". A small pill inside says "数值仅作示意".
Middle card heading "这次低分能否用于保护？"; under it four checked lines, without asserting that they always hold: "本次新评分" / "证据完整" / "同一任务类别" / "同一计划版本与评分标准". Checks are requirements to inspect, not an experimental validation result.
Upper outcome card amber heading "条件满足"; large bold outcome "使用主力组"; supporting line "完整低分触发保护".
Lower outcome card teal heading "条件不满足"; large bold outcome "可使用省钱组"; supporting line "此例的简单概率已达阈值".
Clearly label upper connecting arrow "是", lower arrow "否".
Bottom band exact wording "缺失或部分评分保持标记；不能当作 0 分触发保护".
Small footer exact wording "默认阈值为策略设置 · 示意数值，非实验测量".
Constraints: preserve the inequalities and decimals exactly. Do not depict partial or missing scores as automatically causing an upgrade. All four applicability checks must be present and readable. No benchmark, price or quality-ranking claim.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a finished 16:9 Chinese PowerPoint-style explanatory slide for a technical article about HiRoute and Jev. Warm white background, dark navy Chinese sans-serif typography, restrained indigo / teal / amber cards, flat editorial illustration, ample whitespace, all Chinese text accurate and highly legible. No UI imitation, no logos, no photos.
Title exact: "有人反馈，也能自主接力"
Subtitle exact: "HiRoute 根据任务进展，为下一阶段选择模型"
Layout: left half two stacked horizontal input lanes. Upper lane indigo heading "有人参与"; body two lines "用户追问、纠正与补充" and "结合上一阶段的实际产出". Lower lane teal heading "自主执行"; body two lines "目标与验收要求" and "持续积累的阶段执行记录". Each lane has one clear arrow toward a shared central card labeled "HiRoute 整理上下文", body "当前任务 + 可见历史". From this card draw arrow to right card "Jev 独立判断" with two equal lines "当前需要多强的能力" and "上一阶段完成得如何". Beneath this right card arrow down to card "HiRoute 选择模型" with body "省钱组 / 主力组". A returning line from this bottom card toward the lower center small card "Agent 继续执行", then back toward input history, labelled "新的执行记录进入后续决策".
Footer exact: "用户无需额外打分 · 阶段评价参与路由 · Agent 按目标完成验收"
Constraints: all card and arrow labels specified verbatim. Human feedback and autonomous execution are two sources that converge, not sequential stages. No claim of evaluating every tool call. No extra text, no fabricated scores, no OpenRouter. Crisp spacious composition.
